violation_type.title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs (26 TAC §747.2301(3))
violation_type.short_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs
violation_type.typical_finding: One infant was left in a play yard after waking up from nap without prompt attention given to the child's physical needs as the child stated: out and the provider left the child in the play yard.
